label: Bible Study
prompt: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a _____ to work.
verse: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
note: Half a wall in record time, despite mockers on the sidelines — the secret was a mind to work.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall _____ for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verse: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
note: Moses reminds Israel: the God who fought for you in Egypt goes before you still — same fighter, new battlefield.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head _____, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
verse: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
note: Out of the furnace: not a hair singed, coats unchanged, not even the smell of smoke on them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: It is he that sitteth upon the _____ of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verse: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
note: God enthroned above the earth's vault, where human beings look like grasshoppers.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Blessed be the Lord, who daily _____ us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verse: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
note: Not weekly, not monthly — the Lord 'daily loadeth us with benefits.' A cart that never comes back empty.
